summary: Join our Advanced Credit Risk Modeling and Analysis Training to gain in-depth knowledge and practical skills for effective credit risk assessment and management
lede: Advanced credit risk modeling helps risk professionals, data scientists and financial analysts develop and evaluate models for default, loss and exposure. The course covers probability of default, loss given default and exposure at default estimation, macroeconomic scenarios for expected credit loss, and model validation through backtesting and performance measures. Learners also explore machine-learning credit scoring and explainability, model governance, and portfolio stress testing.
audienceIntro: This quantitative program is specifically engineered for risk professionals, data scientists, and financial analysts who are responsible for developing, validating, or overseeing credit risk models within financial institutions.
modules: Foundations of Advanced Credit Risk Modeling
Dynamic Stress Testing and Portfolio Analytics
prerequisites: Participants must have a solid foundation in statistical concepts (e.g., regression analysis, probability distributions) and prior exposure to credit risk principles. Working knowledge of Python, R, or advanced SAS is highly recommended, as hands-on exercises will involve executing and modifying quantitative scripts. No prior experience with advanced machine learning algorithms is required, but familiarity with data manipulation and basic coding logic is essential for maximizing the value of the practical workshops.
